subject: CS230
filterSummary: Filtered out 430 videos due to wrong language (Hindi, Telugu, etc.), insufficient duration (<60s), off-topic content, and low relevance/quality. Selected the best 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering the 5 difficult OOP topics, prioritizing clarity, relevance, and educational value.

videos.title: 8.6: Pass by Value vs. Pass by Reference - Processing Tutorial
videos.filter_reason: Excellent visual explanation of pass by value vs reference using Processing, clearly covering objects vs primitives.

videos.title: Java Type Casting Tutorial #55
videos.filter_reason: Clear Java type casting tutorial by Alex Lee, covering implicit and explicit casting with high production quality.

videos.title: Static vs Non-Static Variables and Methods In Java - Full Simple Tutorial
videos.filter_reason: Comprehensive explanation of static vs non-static variables and methods in Java with practical examples.

videos.title: #25 Method Overloading in Java
videos.filter_reason: Telusko's method overloading tutorial explained clearly with examples, covering signatures and overloading.

videos.title: Function Oriented vs Object Oriented Design Approach | Software Design Approaches
videos.topic_ar: نهج البرمجة التركيبية في البرمجة الكائنية
videos.filter_reason: Gate Smashers contrasts function-oriented and OO design, illustrating modular approach in OOP effectively.

videos.title: #22 [c++] - Function part 5 (Call By Reference vs Call By Value)
videos.filter_reason: Adel Nasim's Arabic C++ tutorial explains call by value vs reference in detail with high views and student engagement.

videos.title: 20- Type Casting
videos.filter_reason: One of the few Arabic videos on type casting with detailed explanation, albeit low production quality.

videos.title: محاضرة 1 | الدرس 6 | الفرق بين المتغيرات والدوال الـ static والـ instance
videos.filter_reason: Clear Arabic lecture on the difference between static and instance variables and methods in Java.

videos.title: الدرس الثامن والثلاثون : مفهوم الـ Method Overloading
videos.filter_reason: Abdullah Almehmadi's lesson on method overloading in Arabic with good viewership and ratings.

videos.title: Monolithic , Modular Monolithic and Microservices (بالعربي)
videos.topic_ar: نهج البرمجة التركيبية في البرمجة الكائنية
videos.filter_reason: Nader Medhat's Arabic discussion on monolithic vs modular monolithic vs microservices, relevant to modular programming in OOP.
